title: bodyDraft
body:
## bodyDraft

Apply mould-release slope to measured planar or cylindrical faces of the current Body solid, keeping an earlier same-Body profile plane fixed. Use Draft before uniform walls, bosses, bores and finishing features. Positive angle and reversed select the slope sign; the neutral plane and optional same-Body datum axis determine its frame. Face intent is resolved with exact cardinality rather than cached native indices. Native Draft remains editable; 2D Draft workbench tools are a separate missing family.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Draft`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `neutralPlane` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `axis` | one node | no | `axis` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` | Release slope in degrees, strictly greater than zero and less than 90; default 3. This is an angular setting, not a length driver. Native geometry must remain one valid solid; a host-valid steep angle can still fail the kernel. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":90,"exclusiveMaximum":true}` | `3` |
| `reversed` | Reverse the draft slope sign without moving the neutral plane. For the XY outline/+Z pull example, false narrows walls with increasingZ and true widens them. Other neutral/pull frames determine the corresponding native convention. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
| `faces` | One to 32 face intents, each selecting exactly one face on the current base. Combine outward planar directions or cylinder axis-line/radius selectors. Missing, equally extreme, ambiguous or duplicate resolved faces fail rather than choosing a first native face. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"union","options":[{"type":"object","title":"Planar wall","properties":{"surface":{"type":"enum","values":["plane"],"required":true},"normal":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"}}},{"type":"object","title":"Cylindrical wall","properties":{"surface":{"type":"enum","values":["cylinder"],"required":true},"axis":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"required":true},"axisPoint":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"default":[0,0,0]},"radius":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000,"required":true}}}]},"minItems":1,"maxItems":32}` | **required** |
